text: The environment feels modern, almost clinical, with sharp lines and glass separating spaces. Everything is purposeful but also a bit disorienting, especially at this angle. Surrounded by reminders of safety—like the fire hose reel—and innovation, I sense a contrast between order and inspiration. Entering the exhibit space, 'R+D' invites curiosity. The colors and text provoke reflection about human connection and technology. I feel intrigued and quietly contemplative, eager to explore what ideas and experiences are curated here, but also aware of my place as an observer within this constructed world.
